episodes.title: No fue un error
episodes.summary: Álex makes his first move on the Lazcano family at Rodolfo's CEO appointment ceremony. Someone identifying as Diana the Huntress offers to help him.

episodes.title: Gente mala
episodes.summary: César refuses to tell Elisa what happened to Sara 18 years ago, so she turns to Álex for answers. Chema and Lorenzo start looking for surrogates.

episodes.title: Cariños, Sara
episodes.summary: Mariana receives a chilling reminder of the crime in the mail. A flashback reveals Sara knew Chema's secret. Elisa breaks into Álex's house.

episodes.title: El monstruo de la familia
episodes.summary: Rodolfo pays a visit to Álex and learns a shocking detail about Sara's death. Elisa wants Álex to trust her but first she must pass a test.

episodes.title: Seguro de vida
episodes.summary: The burden of having to keep all the Lazcano secrets starts taking a toll on Elroy. Elisa and Álex attend a masquerade party at the casino.

episodes.title: Cacería
episodes.summary: After César's darker side is brutally exposed at the masquerade, the Lazcano siblings' loyalty begins to shift. Elroy's troubled past is disclosed.

episodes.title: El miedo y la culpa
episodes.summary: Álex and the Lazcano siblings go to the family estate. César's casino empire starts to crumble as the events at the masquerade go public.

episodes.title: Donde los sueños se hacen realidad
episodes.summary: Another suspect in Sara's death comes into play. Chema shares a surprise with his family at a dinner party but a secret exposed steals the spotlight.

episodes.title: Ver el mundo arder
episodes.summary: Álex and Rodolfo delve into the past to discover the identity of Diana the Huntress. Elisa helps Bruno figure out what happened to Emara.

episodes.title: Dos tumbas
episodes.summary: Flashbacks unravel that fateful day in 2001. Although Sara's diary seems to hold the key to her murder, a secret hidden in a wall tells another story.

episodes.title: Las dos caras de Sara
episodes.summary: The corpse found in the backyard threatens to put Álex back in jail. To prove his innocence, he looks for answers with a psychiatrist who treated Sara.

episodes.title: Sangre en las manos
episodes.summary: Lorenzo agrees to be Álex's lawyer. Mariana decides what to do with Elroy. Elisa becomes collateral damage in one of Álex's attacks against César.

episodes.title: Derrumbe
episodes.summary: Álex's obsession with revenge prompts Elisa to make a choice. Moncho breaks into Chema and Lorenzo's house. Sara learns a shocking truth about herself.

episodes.title: Todo queda en tus manos
episodes.summary: Six months later, Álex discovers the identity of the corpse in his backyard. Meanwhile, César has disappeared and Elisa comes back from Europe.

episodes.title: Los muertos hablan
episodes.summary: Álex helps Lorenzo and Chema with the aftermath of what happened at their house. Sergio targets Elisa to hurt César. Nicandro meets up with Marifer.

episodes.title: Esto es personal
episodes.summary: An officer shows up at Lorenzo's office to inquire about Moncho. Marifer discloses her plan to find her mom to Nicandro. Álex focuses on finding Elisa.

episodes.title: Nunca fuimos amigos
episodes.summary: Flashbacks reveal Sara and Marifer's connection. Moncho's brother exacts his revenge. Nicandro hands Álex the ultimate proof of Sara's double life.

episodes.title: Yo maté a Sara
episodes.summary: A videotape hidden in Sara's closet becomes a key piece of evidence that makes everyone realize they've been seeking the murderer in the wrong place.

episodes.title: Presunción de muerte
episodes.summary: While investigating the link between Nicandro and Dr. Alanís, Álex uncovers a key suspect. Rodolfo asks Álex to help him bring his father to justice.

episodes.title: Complejo de Medusa
episodes.summary: Sara tells Nicandro's dad about his son's drug business. Reinaldo offers Marifer a deal. Álex secures protection for Chema. Nicandro visits Daniela.

episodes.title: Viva o muerta
episodes.summary: Lucía's arrival takes Álex's investigation in another direction. A new lawyer takes Chema's case. César shows up at Álex's house to reclaim his money.

episodes.title: Bienvenidos al Centro Medusa
episodes.summary: Álex fights for his life in the hospital. A distressed Chema asks his mom for help. A flashback shows how Sara became the focus of Reinaldo's experiment.

episodes.title: Ratones de laboratorio
episodes.summary: Worried about her treatment, Sara attempts to expose Reinaldo. Chema is admitted to the Medusa Center. César reveals crucial information to Álex.

episodes.title: Qué pasó con Sara
episodes.summary: César pays a visit to Tonya and resorts to a drastic method to get information about Sara. Under Reinaldo's watch, Chema undergoes horrifying treatment.

episodes.title: ¿Qué hiciste, Sara?
episodes.summary: When the truth of what happened to Sara is finally exposed, Álex unleashes one last act of revenge on the Medusa Center.
